==Problem==

Let <imath>x=-2016</imath>. What is the value of <imath>\Bigg\vert\Big\vert |x|-x\Big\vert-|x|\Bigg\vert-x</imath> ?

<imath>\textbf{(A)}\ -2016\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 0\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 2016\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 4032\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 6048</imath>

==Solution 1==
Substituting carefully, <imath>\Bigg\vert\Big\vert 2016-(-2016)\Big\vert-2016\Bigg\vert-(-2016)</imath>

becomes <imath>|4032-2016|+2016=2016+2016=4032</imath> which is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}}</imath>.

==Solution 2==

Solution by e_power_pi_times_i

Substitute <imath>-y = x = -2016</imath> into the equation. Now, it is <imath>\Bigg\vert\Big\vert |y|+y\Big\vert-|y|\Bigg\vert+y</imath>. Since <imath>y = 2016</imath>, it is a positive number, so <imath>|y| = y</imath>. Now the equation is <imath>\Bigg\vert\Big\vert y+y\Big\vert-y\Bigg\vert+y</imath>. This further simplifies to <imath>2y-y+y = 2y</imath>, so the answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 4032}</imath>
